  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  May 14, 2021

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Himmelrich at 5:06 p.m.,
  on Friday, May 14, 2021, via teleconference pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 at
  https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/hqwabgrf

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Sue Himmelrich
  Mayor Pro Tem Kristin McCowan
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Christine Parra

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Lane Dilg
  Assistant City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:06 p.m., with all
  members present.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.

  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:07 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 9:08 p.m., with all members present except
  Councilmembers Brock and McKeown, to report the following:

  Mayor Himmelrich advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 9:09 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Nikima S. Newsome  Sue Himmelrich
  Assistant City Clerk  Mayor

  1  May 14, 2021
